tasks.label: find-next-build-processes
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'next build' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-List

tasks.label: find-next-build-processes-2
args: wmic process where "CommandLine like '%next build%'" get ProcessId,Name,CommandLine

tasks.label: find-next-build-processes-3
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*next build*' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: find-next-build-processes-4
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*next build*" } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize
